title: OutlineWars GUI
description: A clean, flat, and distraction-free GUI & HUD overlay designed for BedWars. Features 128+ custom textures for max visibility in PvP!
body:
Overview: Elevate your PvP experience with the official OutlineWars GUI! This is a specialized overlay resource pack that completely overhauls your HUD, menus, and containers. Built by the SquadXTeam, we manually redesigned 128 textures to give you the cleanest screen possible during intense BedWars and SkyWars matches.

✨ Key Features:

Ultra-Clean HUD: Custom, flat-colored hearts, armor icons, food bars, and crosshairs. We removed all unnecessary shading so you can focus 100% on the fight.

Optimized Menus: Redesigned inventory, chests, and crafting tables that won't distract you while looting or managing items.

Universal Overlay: You can use this pack on its own, OR put it at the top of your resource pack list to apply our custom GUI over any of your favorite texture packs!

Perfect Match: Designed to pair flawlessly with the original OutlineWars 16x texture pack.

⚙️ How to use: Just place this pack at the TOP of your selected resource packs list in the game settings to ensure our GUI overrides the default or other packs.

Developed by SquadXTeam.
